verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents a tokenization feature that provisions Mastercard and Visa cards into Apple Pay, Google Pay and other digital wallets. However, nothing in the pack shows listing the tokens created for a card, identifying which wallet or merchant holds each token, or revoking tokens independently of the PAN. Wallet provisioning is an adjacent capability, not token lifecycle management, so this applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, network tokens are first-class — I can see and manage the tokens created for a card, know which wallet or merchant holds them, and revoke them independently of the PAN
